recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 可見成片的大型非典型淋巴細胞，核呈泡狀、核仁明顯，並有分裂象，夾雜小淋巴球與漿細胞；大型細胞比例高，對應高級別（grade 3）淋巴瘤樣肉芽腫的外觀。
features: Numerous large atypical lymphoid cells with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli
Irregular, occasionally multilobated nuclei; a mitotic figure is present
Moderate amphophilic cytoplasm in the large cells
Admixed small lymphocytes and plasma cells in a polymorphous background
describe_en: Sections show a polymorphous lymphoid infiltrate dominated by large atypical cells with vesicular chromatin, prominent nucleoli, irregular nuclear contours, and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm. Mitotic activity is present, and small lymphocytes and plasma cells are admixed. Angiocentricity and necrosis are not evaluable in this high-power field. In conjunction with CD20 and EBER staining, findings are consistent with lymphomatoid granulomatosis with a high proportion of large cells (grade 3 pattern).

ddx.vs: Cytology overlaps with grade 3 LYG; the distinction relies on angiocentric-angiodestructive growth, necrosis, a T-cell-rich background, and EBER positivity in LYG.
HRS cells in CHL are CD30/CD15-positive with weak PAX5 and absent CD20/CD45, unlike the CD20-positive large B cells of LYG.
ALCL cells are uniformly strong CD30-positive T/null cells with hallmark horseshoe nuclei and lack CD20 and EBER.
